Dana P: Quick check-in  AP-644 action items show as overdue in the tracker. Owners: @Kofi A (db failover test), @Li W (service circuit-breaker thresholds). Who's got status?
Kofi A: I'm blocked on the cloud infra window; I requested a maintenance slot in INFRA-210 but no confirmation yet.
Li W: Circuit-breaker thresholds drafted, but I haven't run validation against prod-like traffic. Need a small traffic replay window. Filed TRAF-54.
remind-bot: Reminder: AP-644 overdue actions. Escalation in 24h if no updates.
Dana P: We need explicit ETAs or I'm reassigning. This has been open >2 weeks. If infra doesn't schedule the window by EOD tomorrow I'll reassign to the on-call owner.
Incident Lead: Tagging Platform Ops for help with infra window. @Platform Ops can you weigh in?
Platform Ops: We can provide a 30m window tomorrow 02:00-02:30 PT if that works. Kofi, Li: confirm and book.
Kofi A: Confirmed, taking the 02:00 window. I'll update tracker and link INFRA-210.
Li W: I'll use the same window for traffic replay. Booking TRAF-54 for that slot and adding validation checklist items.
remind-bot: Closure verification scheduled for 2026-11-10 17:00 PT.
Dana P: Also noting a pattern: several postmortem actions stall at "schedule slot". Proposing a new action: "reserve infra slot before owner assignment". Adding to the template now.
Kofi A: INFRA-210 updated and slot confirmed. Running failover test in the window, will post logs to tracker.
Li W: Replay and validation complete; thresholds tuned, PR: https://git.redwood.ai/org/repo/pull/740.
Incident Lead: Verified logs and PR. Marking AP-644 resolved in tracker. Creating a retro card to enforce "reserve infra slot" as a gating checklist item.
Dana P: Thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker after this please escalate immediately rather than letting ownership lapse.
